description: Week 33 (2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16; Dr. Luitel, 2026-11-09: speaker-specific folds are the main protocol, the validation speaker chooses, every model kept until this week's results are in): the SVM probe probe30_whisper_large_v3_so4 (4c19be6604d3), its layer fixed, as classical_spk32_whisper ran it, with three classes (no neutral), in speaker-specific folds (one speaker tests, the other speaker of the same session validates, the other eight speakers train), refitted on training plus validation; C and gamma are chosen on each fold's validation speaker as the probe chooses them. Only data.label_set differs from classical_spk32_whisper. Seed 1. How the results are read is fixed in RULE_week33.txt (analyses/week33_prep_20261109) before any run. Runs on CPUs.
